why: owner 28 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the item tooltip fix and the taint sweep

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- The tooltip of a weapon enchant button (the weapon itself) is no longer run through the buff function. Its item lines filled the report with dozens of false misses and cost most of the time of the buff module.
- When the game blocks an action bar button, the report line now also checks every global and the bar frames for a value WoWFA wrote (only when the game's own taint log is off).

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- The copy buttons no longer call the game's clipboard function. System lines reach the report again after a clear. Channel notices, NEW on the game menu, the macro window, a mount tooltip, Camp Benefits. A window first shown in a fight no longer takes the keyboard. The trace and the timers in the report.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
